description:
**Position:** Labour Officer

**Location :** Pune (Pimpri\- Chinchwad )

**Experience :** 5\-10 Year

**Role Purpose**

The Labour Officer will be responsible for managing labour relations, contractor coordination, manpower availability, labour welfare, and discipline across all project sites. The role acts as the primary point of contact for all labour and contractual manpower matters and ensures smooth workforce operations in support of project execution.

The candidate should possess strong interpersonal, coordination, crisis\-handling, and field management skills with readiness to travel to project locations whenever required.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Labour Management at Site**

* Act as the primary point of contact for all labour\-related matters at project sites.
* Maintain labour discipline, attendance, productivity, and workforce engagement.
* Handle day\-to\-day labour concerns, disputes, grievances, and conflict resolution.
* Ensure proper coordination between site supervisors and labour teams.
* Monitor labour deployment and workforce utilization as per project requirements.
* Conduct regular interactions with workers to maintain smooth site operations.
* Ensure timely resolution of labour issues to avoid project disruptions.

**2\. Contractor \& Labour Sourcing**

* Identify, evaluate, and onboard reliable labour contractors.
* Arrange skilled, semi\-skilled, and unskilled manpower as per project requirements.
* Maintain an updated database of labour contractors and manpower availability.
* Ensure timely mobilization and deployment of labour for ongoing and upcoming projects.
* Coordinate with contractors for urgent and emergency manpower requirements.
* Monitor contractor performance, workforce quality, and labour availability.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with labour contractors and workforce suppliers.

**3\. Labour Welfare \& Compliance**

* Ensure availability of basic labour welfare facilities at project sites and labour camps.
* Address emergency situations related to labour, worker welfare, safety, and accommodation.
* Support implementation and adherence to labour laws and statutory compliance requirements.
* Maintain records related to labour attendance, contractor manpower, worker documentation, and compliance.
* Coordinate with HR and project teams for labour documentation, verification, and record management.
* Assist in audits and inspections related to labour compliance.

**4\. Coordination \& Reporting**

* Provide daily, weekly, and monthly manpower status reports to management.
* Highlight operational risks and concerns, including:
* Labour shortages
* Labour disputes
* Delays due to manpower issues
* Contractor\-related challenges
* Support project managers in workforce planning and manpower budgeting.
* Coordinate with HR, Administration, Procurement, and Project Teams to fulfill workforce requirements.
* Track labour productivity and recommend corrective actions when necessary.

**5\. Site Visits \& Travel**

* Visit project sites regularly for labour monitoring and issue resolution.
* Travel to outstation project locations for short\-term and extended visits whenever required.
* Ensure labour camp discipline, welfare standards, and operational compliance during site visits.
* Conduct periodic reviews of labour conditions and contractor performance at project locations.

**Experience**

* **5–10 years experience** in:
* Factory HR / Labour Officer role
* Construction / infrastructure sites
* Manufacturing units with contract labour
* Experience handling **blue\-collar workforce at scale** is essential

**Skills Required**

* Strong **people handling** and negotiation skills
* Ability to manage **unstructured labour environments**
* Practical knowledge of:
* Labour laws
* Contractor management
* Problem\-solving attitude with field orientation
* Ability to work under pressure and travel frequently

**Preferred Background**

* Experience in:
* Construction companies
* Waterproofing / civil contracting
* Manufacturing plants with contract labour

**Key Success Metrics**

* No site shutdown due to labour shortage
* Timely availability of manpower across projects
* Reduction in labour disputes/issues
* Efficient reliever planning for supervisors
* Compliance with labour regulations

**Reporting To**

* Operations Head / Project Director

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹480,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

* Support NPD/engineering team during proto builds, pilot runs, and engineering changes; ensure smooth implementation on the line.

* Diploma / BE in Mechanical, Electrical, Production, or Industrial Engineering (ITI with long experience can be considered for smaller plant).

title: Product Data Executive
description:
**About Qwikxy**

Qwikxy is a fast\-growing e\-commerce platform focused on delivering a seamless product discovery and purchase experience. Our catalogue team is the backbone of what customers see — accurate, complete, and well\-structured product data is critical to our success.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a sharp, detail\-oriented fresher to join our catalogue team as a Product Data Executive. In this role, you will be responsible for creating, verifying, and managing product listings on the Qwikxy platform — ensuring every product is accurately represented, correctly categorised, and error\-free before going live.

**Role Title**

Product Data Executive

**Department**

Catalogue \& Product Operations

**Employment Type**

Full\-Time

**Experience**

Fresher (0–1 year)

**Location**

Bengaluru, Karnataka (On\-site)

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and upload detailed product listings on the Qwikxy platform, ensuring all attributes (title, description, category, price, images, SKU, specifications) are accurately captured.
* Maintain and update Excel\-based product master sheets, using advanced features such as VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and data validation to track and manage catalogue data.
* Analyse end\-to\-end product data flow — from source input to live display on the website — and identify where data might break, get mis formatted, or fail to reflect correctly on the frontend.
* Coordinate with the backend/tech team to understand how product data is processed through the system (APIs, database fields, mapping logic) and flag inconsistencies or data mismatches proactively.
* Perform thorough QA checks on uploaded products to ensure zero display errors, broken attributes, or missing fields on the live platform.
* Build and maintain structured reports and dashboards in Excel to track upload progress, error rates, and catalogue health metrics.
* Document standard operating procedures (SOPs) for product creation workflows to ensure consistency across the team.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with the tech, design, and business teams to resolve data issues quickly.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Bachelor's degree in any discipline (BCA, B.Tech, or any equivalent qualification preferred).**
* **Proficiency in:** Advanced Microsoft Excel:

◦ Formulas: VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX\-MATCH, IFERROR, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS

◦ Pivot Tables \& Charts for data summarisation and reporting

◦ Data Validation, Conditional Formatting, and Drop\-down Lists

◦ Power Query or basic Macros (good to have)

* **Foundational understanding of:** Web \& Backend Basics:

◦ How websites and web applications work (frontend vs backend)

◦ What APIs are and how data flows between systems

◦ Basic familiarity with JSON/XML data structures (ability to read, not necessarily code)

◦ Understanding of database concepts like fields, records, and data types

* **Ability to spot discrepancies in large datasets and product information.** Attention to Detail
* **Capable of tracing a data issue back to its root cause systematically.** Logical Reasoning
* **Comfortable picking up new tools, platforms, and internal systems with minimal hand\-holding.** Quick Learner
* **Clear written and verbal communication to coordinate with tech and business stakeholders.** Communication

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to e\-commerce platforms (Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub, Shopify, etc.)
* Basic knowledge of HTML or how product attributes render on a web page
* Familiarity with Google Sheets and collaboration tools like Notion or Confluence
* Experience with any PIM (Product Information Management) tool

**What We Offer**

* A high\-ownership role from Day 1 — your work directly impacts what customers see on the platform.
* Exposure to the full product operations lifecycle in a high\-growth e\-commerce environment.
* Mentorship from experienced catalogue and tech leads.
* Structured learning path with clear growth milestones.
* Competitive fresher compensation.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹23,000\.00 per month

title: HR recruiter
description:
**HR Recruiter job description**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a proactive and results\-driven Recruiter to join our Human Resources team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, attracting, and on boarding top talent to support business goals. You will play a critical role in driving our hiring strategies and ensuring a seamless recruitment process.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Talent Acquisition and Recruitment:**

* **Job Postings and Descriptions:** Creating and publishing job descriptions on various platforms to attract qualified candidates.
* **Screening and Shortlisting:** Reviewing resumes, conducting initial interviews, and narrowing down candidates based on role requirements.
* **Interview Coordination:** Scheduling and organizing interviews with hiring managers, panels, or leadership.
* **Offer Negotiation and Issuance:**
* Drafting, reviewing, and issuing offer letters and employment contracts.
* Communicating compensation, benefits, and other job details with selected candidates.

**2\. Onboarding and Induction:**

* Coordinating pre\-joining formalities like document collection, background verification.
* Organizing new hire orientations to familiarize employees with company policies and culture.

**3\. Maintaining Employee Data:**

* **HRIS Management:**
* Recording and updating employee information, such as personal details, joining details, and role changes.
* Tracking probation, confirmations, and contract renewals.
* Maintaining documentation for compliance purposes, such as employment contracts, offer letters, and verification documents.

**4\. Exit Formalities:**

* **Resignation Handling:** Accepting resignation letters and initiating the offboarding process.
* **Clearance Process:** Coordinating with various departments for no\-dues clearance.
* **Exit Interviews:** Conducting interviews to gather feedback and improve the recruitment process.
* **Document Issuance:** Preparing and issuing relieving letters, experience certificates.

**5\. Compliance and Reporting:**

* Ensuring adherence to labor laws and organizational policies during recruitment and offboarding.
* Generating recruitment and attrition reports to analyze trends and improve processes.

**6\. Stakeholder Coordination:**

* Collaborating with hiring managers to understand job requirements and talent expectations.
* Acting as a liaison between employees, leadership, and external recruitment agencies when required.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
* Proven experience in recruitment.
* Strong knowledge of sourcing techniques, recruitment tools, and applicant tracking systems (ATS).
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with employment laws and best practices in recruitment.
* A positive attitude and a passion for identifying and on boarding top talent.

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* A collaborative and supportive work environment.
* Opportunities for growth and professional development.
* A chance to work with a forward\-thinking and innovative team.

description:
**About the Role**

We’re seeking a mid\-level FP\&A Manager to own budgeting, forecasting, and performance insights that drive decision\-making across the business. You’ll partner closely with leadership and cross\-functional teams to translate financial data into clear, actionable recommendations.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Budgeting and Forecasting**: Lead the annual planning cycle and maintain rolling forecasts for revenue, opex/capex, and cash flow; identify risks and opportunities early and propose course corrections.
* **Variance Analysis**: Compare plan vs. actuals, explain performance drivers with clarity, and recommend corrective or acceleration actions.
* **Financial Modeling**: Build robust, scenario\-based models for pricing, new products/facilities, investments, and market/economic shifts; test sensitivities and communicate implications.
* **Management Reporting and Storytelling**: Craft concise, insight\-led dashboards and presentations for CEOs, CFOs, and functional leaders to support strategic and operational decisions.
* **Business Partnering**: Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Operations to connect operational drivers to financial outcomes and improve forecast accuracy.
* **Process and Controls**: Improve planning/reporting processes, standardize templates, and enhance data quality and timeliness.

**Key Skills and Experience**

* **Advanced Data Proficiency**: Expert Excel skills (modelling, Power Query/Power Pivot preferred) and strong data visualization experience (e.g., Power BI).
* **Enterprise Tools**: Hands\-on experience with enterprise performance management/planning platforms (e.g., SAP EPM/BPC, SAP Analytics Cloud, or similar).
* **Financial Acumen**: Solid grasp of P\&L, balance sheet, and cash flow dynamics; ability to connect commercial and operational KPIs to financial results.
* **Communication**: Clear, structured communicator who can translate complex analyses into executive\-ready narratives and visuals.
* **Collaboration**: Track record of partnering across functions to drive accountability and outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field; MBA/FCA/CMA is a plus.
* 4–7 years of relevant FP\&A or corporate finance experience in a mid\-to\-large or fast\-growing organization.
* Demonstrated experience owning budgeting/forecasting cycles and building scenario models.
* Comfortable working with large datasets; SQL exposure is a plus.

**Success Measures (Within 6–12 Months)**

* Increased forecast accuracy and on\-time monthly reporting.
* Clear driver\-based models in place for revenue, margin, and cash flow.
* Executable insights presented to leadership with measurable impact on decisions.
* Streamlined planning processes and standardized reporting.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Competitive salary and performance bonus.

Area Head – Gold Loans is responsible for driving strategy execution, growth, profitability, portfolio quality and operational governance across the assigned area. The role ensures achievement of AUM, disbursement, P\&L, branch expansion and compliance targets through leadership of teams. **2\) Dimensions:** *Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.* **New Relationship**

The incumbent will be responsible for monitoring portfolio and market updates.**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges:** Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section **(****Max 3975 Characters)**
==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context** **Job Context:**  

Translate regional gold loan strategy into area execution plan while balancing rapid growth with strict risk discipline. This position execution of business initiatives, overseeing profit and loss statements, ensuring adherence to risk management and regulatory compliance, and leading teams to meet established targets. **Key Challenges:*** Driving rapid AUM growth while maintaining strict LTV norms, low NPAs and strong collateral cover amid gold price volatility.
* Ensuring zero deviation compliance with RBO guidelines across a large, distributed branch network without slowing business momentum.
* Preventing fraud, jewelry substitution, internal collusion and security breaches while scaling operations
* Improving performance of underproductive branches and optimizing fixed costs in a high volume, low ticker business.
* Protecting branch reputation by delivering transparent, fast and respectful customer experiences for a highly emotional asset.

title: Special Education Teacher
company: prayaas therapy and child development center
description:
1\. Special Educator (Special Education Teacher)

Purpose of Role: To provide tailored academic and developmental support to students with diverse learning needs, ensuring they meet their educational potential through individualized instruction.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a dedicated Special Educator to join our team. You will be responsible for assessing student needs, developing Individualized Education Plans (IEPs), and adapting the general curriculum to accommodate various learning disabilities (including Autism, ADHD, Dyslexia, and other developmental delays). You will work closely with parents, general education teachers, and therapists to create a supportive learning environment.

Key Responsibilities:

\* Assessment \& Planning: Assess students’ skills to determine their needs and develop Individualized Education Plans (IEPs) with specific, measurable goals.

\* Instruction: Plan, organize, and assign activities that are specific to each student’s abilities; teach socially acceptable behavior and daily living skills.

\* Curriculum Adaptation: Modify the general education curriculum for special\-needs students based upon a variety of instructional techniques and technologies.

\* Collaboration: Meet with parents, counselors, and administrators to discuss student progress; co\-teach with regular education teachers to support inclusion.

\* Documentation: Maintain accurate and complete student records, progress reports, and compliance with all state/federal regulations.

Qualifications:

\* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Special Education.

\* Valid State/National Special Education Teaching License/Certification.

\* Experience working with children/adults with special needs (specific diagnosis experience can be specified here, e.g., ASD).

\* Knowledge of IEP development and special education laws (e.g., IDEA).

2\. Speech Therapist (Speech\-Language Pathologist)

Purpose of Role: To diagnose and treat individuals with speech, language, voice, fluency, and swallowing disorders, helping them communicate effectively.

Job Summary:

We are hiring a compassionate and skilled Speech\-Language Pathologist (SLP). You will evaluate and treat clients with communication disorders, ranging from articulation and fluency issues to complex language processing disorders. You will work within a multidisciplinary team to help clients achieve functional communication goals.

Key Responsibilities:

\* Evaluation: Conduct comprehensive screenings and assessments to identify speech, language, and swallowing disorders.

\* Treatment Planning: Create and implement individualized treatment plans tailored to the specific needs of the client (e.g., articulation therapy, language intervention, dysphagia management).

\* Therapy Delivery: Provide individual or group therapy sessions using evidence\-based techniques and therapeutic tools (including AAC devices where necessary).

\* Family Education: Counsel and train family members and caregivers on how to support the client’s communication development at home.

\* Collaboration: Consult with teachers, special educators, and other therapists to integrate speech goals into the client's daily routine.

Qualifications:

\* Master’s degree in Speech\-Language Pathology.

\* Valid State License and ASHA Certification (CCC\-SLP) or equivalent national certification.

\* Experience with pediatric or adult populations (depending on your facility's focus).

\* Proficiency in using Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) devices is a plus.

3\. Occupational Therapist (OT)

Purpose of Role: To help individuals develop, recover, and improve the skills needed for daily living and working, focusing on physical, sensory, and cognitive independence.

Job Summary:

We are looking for an Occupational Therapist to help our clients participate fully in their daily lives. You will work with individuals who have conditions that are mentally, physically, developmentally, or emotionally disabling. Your focus will be on "occupations" of daily life—from self\-care (dressing, eating) to school performance (handwriting, focus) and play.

Key Responsibilities:

\* Evaluation: Assess clients’ physical, sensory, and cognitive abilities to determine their functional levels and barriers to independence.

\* Intervention: Develop therapeutic programs to improve fine motor skills, sensory processing, hand\-eye coordination, and daily living skills (ADLs).

\* Sensory Integration: Design and implement sensory diets and environmental modifications to help clients regulate their sensory systems.

\* Equipment Recommendation: Advise on and teach the use of adaptive equipment (e.g., pencil grips, wheelchairs, sensory aids) to replace lost function.

\* Documentation \& Review: Regularly evaluate progress, modifying treatment plans as necessary, and maintain precise clinical documentation.

Qualifications:

\* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Occupational Therapy.

\* Valid State License and National Board Certification (NBCOT).

\* Strong background in Sensory Integration (SI) therapy is often highly valued.

\* Ability to lift and move clients/equipment as needed.

Quick Comparison for Hiring Managers

If you are hiring for a center, it is helpful to know the distinct "lane" for each professional to avoid role confusion:

\| Role \| Primary Focus \| Key Outcome \|

\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|

\| Special Educator \| Academics \& Behavior \| The student can access the curriculum and learn in a classroom setting. \|

\| Speech Therapist \| Communication \& Swallowing \| The client can speak, understand language, and express needs clearly. \|

\| Occupational Therapist \| Daily Function \& Motor Skills \| The client can independently perform tasks like writing, dressing, and playing. \|

**About the Company**

Miracles is a technology\-driven proprietary trading and research firm building scalable, high\-performance quantitative trading systems. We operate across Indian financial markets including NSE, BSE, and MCX, with a strong emphasis on data\-driven research, innovation, and systematic trading.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a **Quantitative Researcher (Fresher)** to join our growing research team. This role is ideal for graduates with strong foundations in mathematics, statistics, and programming who are eager to apply their analytical skills to real\-world financial markets.

You will work closely with senior researchers and contribute to strategy research, data analysis, backtesting, and real\-time model validation across NSE, BSE, and MCX markets.

**We prefer candidates from Ahmedabad \& Gujarat.**

Key Responsibilities

* Clean, preprocess, and structure historical and real\-time market data (tick\-level and OHLC) using Python, Pandas, and NumPy for quantitative research.
* Handle large\-scale datasets including per\-second index data, option chain data, and derived metrics; apply statistical analysis and analytical reasoning to identify patterns.
* Assist in developing intraday trading strategies (VWAP\-based, breakout, mean\-reversion) using Python and data visualization libraries like Matplotlib and Seaborn.
* Implement and validate statistical models including z\-score, correlation, and spread\-based strategies; apply probability and hypothesis testing for idea validation.
* Conduct backtesting on historical datasets and analyze performance metrics (PnL, win rate, drawdown) using Pandas, NumPy, and Jupyter Notebook / Google Colab.
* Build and maintain dashboards and visualization tools using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Zoho Analytics to track strategy performance and market behavior.
* Monitor live data streams and validate real\-time strategy outputs against backtested results; handle forward\-fill logic, missing ticks, and data irregularities using Python.
* Collaborate with senior researchers, developers, and trading teams to support research initiatives and contribute to idea generation.

**Required Skills \& Tools**

* Python (mandatory) — primary language for all data and research tasks
* Pandas — data manipulation, cleaning, and time\-series handling

* Matplotlib — charting and strategy performance visualization
* Seaborn — statistical data visualization

* Statistical Analysis — probability, z\-score, correlation, hypothesis testing

* Analytical Reasoning — pattern recognition and systematic thinking

**Education**

* Mathematics
* Statistics / Applied Statistics
* Physics

**What You Will Learn**

* Real\-world quant trading systems — not theoretical
* Working with tick\-level data and live trading environments
* Full strategy lifecycle: idea → backtest → validation → live deployment
* NSE / BSE / MCX market microstructure, options \& derivatives

**Preferred Traits**

* Strong analytical thinking and curiosity to explore data
* Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a fast\-paced research environment
* Attention to detail and methodical problem\-solving approach
* Interest in financial markets and systematic trading

title: Sr. Manager Taxation
description:
**Job title: Sr. Manager Taxation**  

**Location: Mumbai**

**About the job**

**Our Team:**


Sanofi India is seeking an experienced and dynamic Senior Manager – Taxation to lead and manage the company's end\-to\-end tax function across direct tax, indirect tax, and transfer pricing. The role is pivotal in ensuring full statutory compliance while driving proactive tax planning and advisory to support Sanofi's business objectives in India. The incumbent will serve as a key finance business partner, working closely with internal stakeholders and external advisors to manage tax risks and optimize the company's tax position. This is a leadership role that requires a blend of deep technical expertise, strategic thinking, and strong stakeholder management skills within a fast\-paced multinational pharmaceutical environment.

**Main responsibilities:**


 1\. Direct Tax


Manage corporate income tax computations, advance tax workings, and ensure timely payment of taxes  

Oversee TDS/TCS compliance including monthly payments, quarterly return filings (Form 24Q, 26Q, 27Q), and issuance of certificates  

Prepare and file annual income tax returns and related forms (e.g., Form 3CEB, 3CD, 29B)  

Lead tax assessments and manage scrutiny proceedings before Assessing Officers, CIT(A), and ITAT  

Monitor and manage tax litigation portfolio; coordinate with external counsel for appeals and hearings  

Track legislative changes and assess their impact on the company's tax position  

2\. Indirect Tax (GST)


Oversee end\-to\-end GST compliance including preparation and filing of GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B, GSTR\-9, and GSTR\-9C  

Manage GST audits, departmental inquiries, and notices; coordinate responses with external advisors  

Drive GST refund claims (export refunds, inverted duty structure) and follow up for timely processing  

Provide advisory on GST implications for new business initiatives, contracts, and supply chain arrangements  

Ensure accurate input tax credit (ITC) reconciliation and compliance with anti\-profiteering provisions  

3\. Transfer Pricing


Prepare and maintain comprehensive Transfer Pricing (TP) documentation including Master File, Local File, and Country\-by\-Country Reporting (CbCR)  

Conduct benchmarking analysis and ensure arm's length pricing for all intercompany transactions  

Manage TP audits and assessments; liaise with external TP advisors and tax authorities  

Review intercompany agreements and ensure alignment with TP policies and OECD guidelines  

Monitor changes in Indian TP regulations and BEPS developments and assess business impact  

4\. Tax Planning \& Advisory


Identify and implement tax optimization opportunities in compliance with applicable laws  

Provide tax advisory on business transactions, new product launches, contracts, and commercial arrangements  

Support M\&A, restructuring, and integration activities from a tax due diligence and structuring perspective  

Advise on withholding tax implications for cross\-border payments and treaty benefits  

Collaborate with the global tax team on international tax matters impacting India operations  

5\. Regulatory \& Statutory Compliance


Liaise with income tax authorities, GST authorities, and other regulatory bodies  

Manage and respond to tax notices, show cause notices, and information requests in a timely manner  

Represent the company at hearings before tax authorities and appellate forums  

Maintain a comprehensive tracker of all ongoing litigation, notices, and compliance deadlines  

Ensure compliance with FEMA, RBI regulations, and other applicable statutes as relevant to the tax function  

6\. Financial Reporting \& Tax Accounting


Support preparation of current and deferred tax provisions under Ind AS 12 / IAS 12  

Ensure accurate tax disclosures in standalone and consolidated financial statements  

Coordinate with statutory auditors and internal auditors on tax\-related matters  

Maintain tax balance sheet reconciliations and support quarterly/annual closing processes  

Provide tax inputs for budgeting, forecasting, and effective tax rate (ETR) analysis  

7\. Stakeholder Management


Partner with Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, Commercial, and HR teams to provide proactive tax guidance  

Manage relationships with external tax advisors, Big 4 firms, and legal counsel  

Coordinate with the global/regional tax team on cross\-border matters and group reporting requirements  

Present tax updates, risk assessments, and planning opportunities to senior leadership  

8\. Team Leadership


Lead, mentor, and develop junior tax professionals within the team  

Foster a culture of continuous learning, compliance excellence, and accountability  

Delegate responsibilities effectively and ensure quality review of all tax deliverables  

Build team capability through training on evolving tax laws and best practices

**About you**

**Education**


Chartered Accountant (CA) – mandatory

**Experience**

* 8–12 years of relevant tax experience
* Industry Preference
* Multinational corporation or Big 4 public accounting firm; pharma/life sciences sector is a plus

**Technical Knowledge**

* Strong command of Indian direct tax laws, GST, transfer pricing regulations, and Ind AS / IFRS Systems
* Proficiency in SAP or similar ERP systems; working knowledge of tax compliance tools

**Additional Qualification**


LLB or postgraduate degree in taxation is an added advantage

**Key Competencies**


Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills – Ability to interpret complex tax laws and translate them into practical business solutions  

Communication \& Stakeholder Management – Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to present tax matters clearly to non\-tax audiences  

Prioritization \& Agility – Capable of managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment  

Integrity \& Attention to Detail – High standards of professional ethics with meticulous attention to accuracy and compliance  

Strategic Thinking with Hands\-On Execution – Ability to think at a strategic level while remaining engaged in operational details  

Collaborative Leadership – Team player who leads by example and builds strong cross\-functional relationships


Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary


Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.


At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.


Watch our ALL IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com!

We are committed to career development for our employees and offer opportunities for growth, learning and building community. With a "work from anywhere" culture, we celebrate diversity in a distributed environment with a presence in 30 countries as well as 20 offices in over 5 continents. Learn more about why it's an exciting time to join Precisely!



Precisely is an AI\-first organization. All employees are expected to demonstrate proficiency in applying AI tools to accelerate their work, improve output quality, and eliminate low\-value tasks. Candidates should be comfortable using generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT) in their day\-to\-day workflows, able to evaluate AI\-generated outputs critically, and open to continuously adopting new AI capabilities as they emerge.

  

**Overview:**



Lead Precisely's global corporate travel program, ensuring a seamless and policy\-compliant travel experience for employees worldwide. You will manage a Travel Administrator based in India and personally support global employees with their travel needs alongside your team. This role combines hands\-on employee support with program leadership, overseeing Concur and Coupa platforms, T\&E card program, supplier relationships, and travel policy. You will partner with Finance, HR, and leadership to drive cost savings, duty\-of\-care compliance, and continuous improvement across the travel function and employee experience.


**What you will do:**


* Own and manage the global corporate travel program, including policy governance and direct support for employees worldwide
* Administer and optimize the Concur travel system and Coupa expense platform for maximum adoption and compliance
* Manage the corporate T\&E card program, including card issuance, tracking, and reconciliation
* Own the strategic relationship with Frosch (Travel Management Company), including conducting regular QBRs, holding them accountable to SLAs, and driving continuous service improvement
* Negotiate and ensure competitive rates and best practices with Frosch and other travel suppliers (airlines, hotels, car rental agencies)
* Lead Travel RFP processes including scoping requirements, managing vendor responses, evaluating proposals, and driving selection decisions
* Maintain high\-quality travel service standards for employees globally, resolving escalations and ensuring a positive traveler experience
* Serve as a direct point of support for global employees on travel bookings, queries, and escalations alongside the travel admin
* Analyze travel spend data, expense reports, and KPIs to identify savings opportunities and policy improvement areas
* Ensure duty\-of\-care obligations are met, including traveler tracking and emergency protocols
* Partner with Finance on expense reporting, budgeting, and audit support
* Develop and communicate travel policy updates to employees globally


**What we are looking for:**


**Required:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Hospitality, Finance, or related field (equivalent work experience accepted)
* Minimum 8 years of corporate travel management experience, including direct employee\-facing support
* Atleast 2 years in a supervisory or team lead role
* Experience with a corporate travel management platform (Concur or similar)
* Experience managing a T\&E card program


**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience managing a TMC relationship (Frosch, BCD, Amex GBT, or similar)
* Experience running a Travel RFP process
* Experience coordinating travel for large\-scale corporate events
* Knowledge of travel risk management and duty\-of\-care frameworks


**AI Skills/Knowledge:**


* Use AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot to analyze travel spend patterns, generate exception reports, and identify policy breaches
* Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated insights and apply findings to program improvements

title: Human Resources Coordinator
description:
We are looking for HR Coordinators who can act as the face of the organization throughout the candidate journey. At CynLr, we believe alignment begins before a person joins, not after. The first interaction a candidate has with us shapes how they understand the company, the role, and the founder’s intent. In this role, you will do the heavy lifting of translating that intent into clear, thoughtful, and compelling communication across every stage of hiring and onboarding.
 



**About the Role** 




 As an HR Coordinator, your primary contribution will be to shape how candidates experience CynLr from the moment they discover an opportunity to the moment they join. You will support hiring teams in carrying the organization’s impression in an insightful, consistent, and high\-context manner. This role combines recruitment coordination, employer branding, stakeholder communication, process discipline, and early\-stage organizational alignment.
 



**What You Will Do** 




 • Applicant stage: Adapt job descriptions to the requirements and audience of each platform, including LinkedIn, the company website, and other relevant channels, to improve discoverability and attractiveness. Research candidate demographics, skill combinations, and platform behavior to determine where and when to publish roles for maximum relevance.
 



 • Campus recruitment: Support high\-coordination campus hiring efforts where the objective is not volume but identifying the right candidate in a difficult market. Help manage large applicant pools, communication flows, institution coordination, and branding touchpoints across campuses.
 



 • Candidate stage: Send and coordinate emails for tests and interviews, share preparation details, ensure support team availability, maintain test records and reports, and contribute to the design of filtering criteria using available assessment data.
 



 • Selected candidate stage: Manage candidate confirmations, coordinate interview logistics with relevant stakeholders, maintain interview performance records, and ensure timely follow\-up communication for all candidates who participate in the process.
 



 • Onboarding stage: Log new joiner details into internal systems, generate employee IDs, coordinate with IT for asset issuance, collect required documents, and administer internal and statutory induction programs.
 



 • Employer impression and communication: Act as a consistent and professional point of contact for candidates, helping remove communication roadblocks and ensuring that the organization’s values, expectations, and founder’s impression are carried meaningfully throughout the journey.
 



**Job Requirements**

**Graduate Engineer Trainee – Supply Chain \& Operations Communications (IIT Graduates Preferred)**  
**Location: Civil Area / Site\-Based Experience: Fresher (Class of 2025 / 2026\)Industry: Infrastructure / Infratech / Manufacturing About Us**

We are not just a software company; we are an infrastructure company whose moat is cutting\-edge workflow technology. We are solving the single biggest bottleneck in the Indian EPC and construction sector: **Material Readiness**.

Every massive infrastructure project is governed by the "Iron Triangle" of **Schedule, Cost, and Quality**, which relies heavily on the 3 Ms: *Material, Manpower, and Machinery*. We own the Material readiness vertical, transforming chaotic site requests into a clean, visible, and bulletproof workflow.

We are looking for sharp, analytical, and highly articulate minds from India's premier institutes (IITs) to bridge the gap between heavy engineering operations and tech\-driven supply chain management.

**The Role: What You Will Do**

As a GET in Supply Chain \& Operations Communications, you won't just sit behind a desk. You will be at the heartbeat of execution, ensuring that the "Site as a Unit" achieves 100% workflow coverage. You will act as the vital communication and operational link between site engineers, stores, and project directors.

* **Drive Site Adoption \& Coverage:** Work directly on\-site to transition stakeholders (Site\-in\-Charge, Project Directors, Store\-in\-Charge, and Field Engineers) from traditional chaos to our structured workflow platform.
* **Operational Communication:** Bridge the communication gap between site reality and downstream procurement. Ensure daily material indents and requests are moving flawlessly from request to receipt.
* **Data\-Driven Supply Chain Management:** Track metrics for high\-value projects (\~₹100 Cr\+ project turnover). Monitor and clear bottlenecks for thousands of active indents.
* **Feedback Loop Creation:** Act as the eyes and ears on the ground. Translate the practical difficulties of users working in the dust and on the move into actionable insights for our Design and Engineering teams.

**What Constitutes a "Win" in This Role?**

* **Not a Win:** A few isolated sign\-ups or getting a couple of engineers to use a tool.
* **A Real Win:** Managing a fully covered, live site where all key stakeholders are actively driving 100% of their material demand through the system.

**Who We Are Looking For (Qualifications)**

* **Education:** B.Tech / Dual Degree from a premier Indian Institute of Technology (**IIT preferred**). Open to all engineering branches (Civil, Mechanical, Production, or Industrial Engineering is a heavy plus).
* **Experience:** **Fresher**. We want raw problem\-solving capability, high energy, and a clean slate.
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be equally comfortable presenting data to a corporate Project Director as you are explaining a workflow to a ground\-level Store\-in\-Charge.
* **Grit \& Mindset:** You believe that "Infra leads and Tech serves". You are willing to work in civil environments/construction sites where the real action happens, prioritizing substance over flashy corporate labels.

**Why Join Us?**

* **High Impact:** You will directly influence the efficiency of ₹100 Crore\+ infrastructure projects.
* **Unmatched Exposure:** You will gain a deep, 360\-degree understanding of supply chain logistics, procurement, and tech deployment in heavy industries.
* **Accelerated Growth:** Working at the intersection of a massive traditional industry and proprietary software gives you a career trajectory that typical corporate IT or traditional manufacturing roles cannot match.

**To Apply:** Please submit your resume highlighting any supply chain, operations, or leadership experience during your time at IIT.

**Location:** Mandla, Madhya Pradesh

**Job Summary**

Fine Vibes Services Private Limited is seeking a dedicated and responsible Solar Plant Maintenance Engineer to manage the operation and maintenance activities of a solar power plant located in Mandla, Madhya Pradesh. The selected candidate will be responsible for routine inspections, plant monitoring, basic troubleshooting, reporting, and ensuring smooth plant operations.

At Vieva Intech, you will work in a prestigious, innovative environment where your contributions directly impact large\-scale production systems.

In this role, you will manage large\-scale databases, handle product deployments, manage application incidents, and ensure seamless system integration across diverse environments while adhering to strict business SLAs.

Key Responsibilities

* **System Administration:** Configure and administer Internet Information Services (IIS) and manage SQL Server environments.

What We Are Looking For (Requirements)

* **Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills:** Ability to diagnose application issues efficiently under pressure to meet time\-sensitive SLAs.
* **Communication:** Proficiency in English (both written and verbal) is highly desired for team collaboration, incident documentation, and status updates.
* **Attributes:** A keen learner with strong analytical skills and a desire to work with large\-scale data.

What You Will Learn \& Gain

Vieva Intech is a fantastic place to build your career. In this role, you will gain hands\-on, deep\-dive experience in:

* Production incident management, troubleshooting workflows, and enterprise SLA management.
* Advanced SQL Server administration and management.

* IIS configuration, administration, and web server management.
* End\-to\-end product testing and deployment methodologies.

* Collaborate actively with senior engineers and internal teams to understand infrastructure and hosting requirements
* Assist in diagnosing and resolving production issues under guidance, ensuring service stability
* Maintain and update technical documentation related to systems, processes, and runbooks


**Who you are:**
* Between 1\-3 years of professional experience
* Solid fundamentals in Linux and basic system administration
* Exposure to at least one data storage system (SQL, NoSQL, RDBMS, or distributed storage), such as
* PostgreSQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse, ScyllaDB, MinIO, etc
* Basic understanding of data backup concepts and disaster recovery principles
* Familiarity with automation or scripting tools such as Ansible, Bash, or Terraform (hands\-on experience is a plus, not mandatory)
* Strong willingness to learn, ask questions, and grow in a distributed systems and infrastructure environment
* Good troubleshooting mindset with the ability to analyse issues and learn from incidents
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
* Exposure to cloud platforms or containerised environments
* Academic or personal projects involving databases, automation, or infrastructure
* Interest in scalability, reliability, and platform engineering best practices


**Why people love working at Brevo:**
* A place to grow, together: Join a diverse, international team in a modern office buzzing with energy and ideas
* Practical perks for everyday balance: Cab Facility and per\-day meal vouchers; Employee\-friendly salary structure; 1\.4x pay on holidays/weekends for critical work; excellent referral program with high\-value gift options (e.g., bike, flight tickets)
* Learning, every step of the way: Over 1,55,000 courses on Udemy, along with facilitator\-led sessions, and personalised training programs tailored to individual and team needs
* Flexible for life: A hybrid setup (2 days WFH), budget for your home workspace, and a generous leave policy to help you balance life and work effortlessly
* Wellbeing that works: INR 10 Lakh medical insurance, maternity support, childcare facilities, and wellness bonuses to keep you and your family covered
* A culture that cares: Annual company off\-sites, inter\-office trips, team outings, active social, green, and LGBTQIA\+ communities, along with festive celebrations \- all making Brevo a vibrant and inclusive workplace


**Our candidate journey:**
* Round 1 \- Screening call with the Talent Acquisition team
* Round 2 \- Face\-to\-Face Interview with our Deputy Platform Manager
* Round 3 \- Virtual Interview with the Hiring Manager
* Round 4 \- Virtual Interview with the VP of Platform


 Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

**About Drone Nuggets:** Drone Nuggets is an aerial education and experiences company on a mission to unlock the sky for everyone. Our hands\-on programs help children and beginners explore aviation, electronics, aerodynamics, RC flight, and drone technology through build kits, guided learning, and live workshops.

**Role Overview:**

Drone Nuggets is looking for instructors who can make learning feel exciting, practical, and memorable. This is not a typical classroom teaching role. It is a hands\-on, high\-energy teaching opportunity for people who enjoy working with young learners, love explaining how things work, and want to grow in a modern learning environment.

This role begins on a contractual basis, but it is designed for people who want to build a longer journey with us. Over time, strong instructors can take on more responsibility across workshop delivery, student experience, curriculum input, and program development.

**Location:** Workshops are currently conducted in Indiranagar, Koramangala, Sarjapur, Cooke Town, and Whitefield. You will primarily be assigned to two of these locations, which can be discussed during the interview.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct hands\-on STEM and drone learning sessions for students.
* Teach concepts such as aerodynamics, basic electronics, drones, and aeromodelling in a clear and engaging way.
* Support students during build activities, experiments, and workshop exercises.
* Help set up, manage, and run sessions smoothly and safely.
* Work closely with the team to improve workshop delivery and student experience.

* Ability to simplify and explain concepts clearly

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior teaching, training, or workshop experience
* Interest in drones, aeromodelling, or hands\-on STEM activities
* Ability to manage groups of students effectively
* Basic troubleshooting skills for simple hardware setups

You do **not** need a degree for this role. What matters most is: A genuine passion for teaching, and a strong thirst for learning.

**Why Join Drone Nuggets:**

* Work in a growing aerospace and STEM education environment with real room for long\-term growth.
* Get hands\-on exposure to practical STEM applications through drones, aeromodelling, electronics, and live workshop delivery.
* Be part of a flexible, project\-based teaching structure that is active, modern, and high\-energy.
* Join a collaborative, learning\-focused team where you can grow into larger responsibilities over time.

description:
Job Title:
 **Senior Agile Coach** 




  





**About the Role :**




  





 The Senior Agile coach will work as part of Agile PMO team and will be responsible for defining, training and implementing agile practices across more than 20 scrums teams located globally in India, Europe and the US. This is a hands\-on role where the agile coach is a role model in agile practices, delivery execution, works closely with the scrum teams to improve their working practices and interrupt their metrics into quality outcomes.

**Agile Leadership** 



* Act as a change agent, helping the organization to understand and implement Agile values and principles.
* Provide leadership by coaching and mentoring teams in Agile values, principles, practices, and frameworks such as Scrum and SAFe.



**Team Enablement** 



* Assist teams in identifying and removing impediments to their progress.
* Set up newly create scrum teams for success by facilitating team kickoffs and team practices.



**Coaching** 



* Coaching and training of teams on all aspects of agile ceremonies and artefacts, including story pointing, sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Coach teams to work closely with Product Owners and team members to ensure backlogs are healthy and are well refined and prioritized.
* Identify training opportunities and provide training and workshops to teams and individuals on Agile methodologies.
* Coach and train teams on the implementation User Stories and requirements management.



**Innovation** 



* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and innovation among teams.
* Develop and implement strategies for enhancing team performance and productivity across the business.
* Collaborate with other agile practitioners and stakeholders to align Agile practices across the organization.



**Metrics** 



* Own and manage the development and tracking of metrics to measure the effectiveness of Agile practices.
* Be able to interrupt the metrics across the organization and identify opportunities for improvement and training.

**Essential** 



* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business, or related field.

title: Head of Onboarding, Strategic Accounts
description:
**About Plum**


Plum is India's leading employee health benefits platform. We cover 600,000 lives across 6,000 companies, growing 80% year on year, cash\-flow profitable in FY27, and recently closed our Series B backed by Peak XV, Tiger Global, and Tanglin.

**1\. The Charter**


Insurance in India still remains a hairy problem. No trust. Overcomplicated systems. Too much paperwork. Communication gaps. Commoditisation. Complication. Manual processes. Opacity. Too much fine print. Warped policies. Scamming. Too many hiding features. Loopholes. Fear. Intimidating processes.


Plum is fixing this. The first 30 days are where trust is built or lost. Your job is to make those 30 days exceptional: for every HR admin, and every employee on their team. What we want to build is a seamless, high\-touch activation journey for every employer and employee — from the moment they sign with Plum to the end of their first 30 days. Not a support queue. Not a checklist. A **red carpet.**

**Your job is to lead this charter, from vision to execution.**

**2\. Why It Matters for Plum**


First impressions are permanent. The first 30 days are when customers decide whether Plum is a *vendor* or a *partner.*


When activation is poor, renewals are transactional. When activation is exceptional, customers become advocates — the kind who renew without negotiation and refer without being asked. Every percentage point of activation gain directly compounds into retention, NPS, and revenue.


We believe the Red Carpet Experience is a growth lever, not an operational cost. Done right, it makes our Account Management team's job easier, our support team's job lighter, and our customers' lives genuinely better.

**3\. What you will do**

* Lead the team which will own and manage the onboarding process for our most important customers from pre\-sales through successful onboarding closeout
* Partner closely with Account Managers and Insurers to ensure smooth customer handoff experience
* Understand customer goals and successfully manage their onboarding timeline towards value
* Report on metrics and customer feedback to assess the impact of successful onboarding and to help identify new customer initiatives and product opportunities
* Help the team deliver live and scalable training sessions customized to customer maturity and needs
* Understand and consult on product and industry best practices in order to act as a trusted advisor to our customers and inspire new possibilities using our product

***Key outcomes you will chase will be the % of customers who achieve the below states in the first 30 days***

* **80%\+** **Activation**


Employees 'Insurance Ready' — app downloaded, profile complete
* **NPS 80** **Advocacy**


Claims NPS target for all first\-month claims
* **3\+** **Viral Loop**


Employees proactively praising Plum to their HR team

**5\. We’d love to hear from you if you have:**

* Strong problem solving skills (ideal experience of 3\+ years at McKinsey, Bain or BCG)
* Total experience of 7\-8 years and above
* Team management experience (can run a large team)
* Deep desire to build with AI (some experience is preferred)
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders at both Plum and insurers to deliver for customers
* Very strong written and verbal communication and high numeric ability
* High customer empathy
* Proven project management skills and experience working with multiple customers / on multiple items concurrently

title: Manager, Talent Acquisition
description:
**About Plum**


Plum is on a mission to make health insurance simple, accessible, and genuinely useful for modern organizations. Backed by Tiger Global and Peak XV Partners, we've built a product people love and now we're scaling it to reach 10 million lives by FY2030\.

**About the Role:**


We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager who can own non\-tech hiring while also leading select mid–senior hires that need sharper judgment, strong stakeholder partnership, and thoughtful candidate engagement, and also has experience in managing teams.


This role sits at the intersection of scale and quality, for someone who knows how to move fast without cutting corners.

**Your Role:**


As a Talent Acquisition Manager, you will own hiring across a wide range of **non\-tech roles** (Sales, Account Management, Finance, HR, Marketing, and similar functions).

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Hiring Ownership**


	+ Lead end\-to\-end hiring for non\-tech roles, planning and executing hiring waves aligned to business demand while maintaining strong funnel health, speed, and conversion.
	+ Own select mid–senior roles, partnering with hiring managers to sharpen role clarity and interview plans, and conducting deeper screening conversations focused on capability, intent, and role fit.
* **Stakeholder Partnership**


	+ Work closely with hiring managers to prioritise roles and timelines
	+ Set clear expectations and provide regular, data\-backed updates
	+ Push back when required with context and solutions
* **Sourcing Strategy**


	+ Build and diversify sourcing pipelines using job boards, referrals, social platforms, and networks
	+ Adapt the sourcing approach based on role complexity and urgency
* **Data \& Reporting**


	+ Track hiring metrics across bulk and mid–senior roles
	+ Use data to identify bottlenecks and improve predictability
	+ Share insights to support workforce planning

**What You Bring**

* **Experience**


	+ Minimum of 6 years of talent acquisition experience
	+ Strong experience hiring across non\-tech roles
	+ Proven ability to balance bulk hiring with nice hiring
	+ Experience in handling teams
* **Hiring Judgment**


	+ Knows when a role needs speed vs depth
	+ Comfortable switching between high\-volume and high\-touch hiring
* **Execution \& Ownership**


	+ Gets into the detail and follows through
	+ Reliable, proactive, and accountable
* **Communication \& Influence**


	+ Strong stakeholder and candidate communication skills Confident pushing back and managing expectations
* **Tools \& Data**


	+ Hands\-on experience with ATS and recruitment tools
	+ Uses data to drive hiring decisions

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Job Description**  

Purpose of the role – mission


The Data Scientist role is responsible for designing and leading universe studies, setting up the extrapolation for Retail Panels, discussing and designing rawdata modelling for non\-coop retailers, and supporting root\-cause analysis in case of client’s complaints when related to these activities.


This role requires strong data fluency, analytical skills with the ability to assess data relevance, and a deep understanding of retail panels and their value.


Key activities:


1\. Universe Studies:

* Design and lead universe studies, acting as a “project manager” for these studies.
* Document methodologies for transparency and provide clear explanations of selected methods.
* Validate the universe estimation.
* Conduct impact analysis of universe studies where relevant.


2\. Extrapolation:

* Design and simulate extrapolation setups for new panels.
* In case of major change in the sample of a channel, redesign its extrapolation matrix, conduct impact analysis where relevant.
* Support StatOps team in case of minor events (how to select a donor shop for a copy shop or a create shop, how to slightly update the extrapolation in case of e.g. empty cell, discuss quality issues / risks in case of weak / weaker sample).
* Assess the compliance of the existing design of extrapolation matrix and eventually recommend improvement (in the design, the sample size \= recommend target for recruitment, etc.)
* Specify sample checks per country\_channel and ensure that they are properly executed by Operation teams.
* Jointly with Operation, review the quality of the existing extrapolation and recommend / redesign if necessary (feedback loop from MDQC teams).
* Update the Target Sample File every year and in case of significant change in the universe or the sample.

  

3\. Modelling:

* Assess the feasibility of non\-coop retailer rawdata modelling outside of the system: business interest (in collaboration with Product), availability of data sources, usability of modelling components
* Design the solution, test the development, review the quality once implemented, review every year the relevancy of the solution
* Once implemented, handover to Operation for ongoing maintenance and execution.
* Support Commercial teams and Client Operation to explain the methodology of a Rawdata modelling.


4\. Quality and Projects

* Implement new country\-channel setups, including reviewing channel definitions, designing universes and samples, and providing setup instructions.
* Resolve Level 2 methodology clarification issues.
* Support Major Data Change required by a redesign recommended by Data Science (major change in the universe, major redesign of an extrapolation, major redesign of a rawdata modelling): support the definition of the action plan, support the client communication.
* Participate to Data Science regional and global projects

 **Qualifications**  

Skills and Qualifications:

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in statistical modeling and data analysis.
* Ability to document and explain complex methodologies clearly.
* Familiarity with root cause analysis methods (such as 5\_why method)
* Excellent communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Knowing production processes for PoS
* Extensive experience of working in an international environment
* Strong quality orientation and solution driven
* Strong command of the English language

  

This role is ideal for individuals with a keen eye for detail and a passion for data and data science. If you enjoy working in a dynamic environment and have the skills listed above, we encourage you to apply for the Data Scientist position.

 **Additional Information** **Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)

title: SRE
description:
**The Impact You’ll Drive**
 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented
 *Site Reliability Engineer* 
 (SRE) to ensure the reliability, availability, and performance of Vegapay's production systems. The ideal candidate will be responsible for monitoring applications and infrastructure, managing production alerts, overseeing critical end\-of\-day processing and driving incident resolution through effective triage and escalation.
   

  

*The Hats You Will Wear*
* Monitor application health checks and ensure high system availability.
* Monitor infrastructure health, including servers, databases, network components, and cloud resources.
* Continuously track Grafana dashboards to identify performance bottlenecks, traffic spikes, and production anomalies.
* Monitor and manage end\-of\-day (EOD) batch processing jobs, scheduled tasks, and cron executions.
* Monitor end\-of\-day reporting jobs and ensure timely completion of core system and operational reports.
* Review, acknowledge, and respond to production alerts across monitoring platforms.
* Create, manage, and track incidents through closure, ensuring adherence to defined SLAs.
* Perform initial triage, coordinate with engineering teams, and follow the escalation matrix for issue resolution.
* Maintain incident logs, post\-incident documentation, and operational runbooks.
* Participate in on\-call rotations and support critical production activities when required.
* Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency improvements.


**The Perfect Fit**
* 2\+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Support, DevOps, or Infrastructure Operations.
* Hands\-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience monitoring scheduled jobs, batch processing systems, and cron\-based workflows.
* Knowledge of incident management processes and production support best practices.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-availability production environment


**The Problem We’re Solving**
 Financial institutions today are held back by legacy systems that are slow, rigid, and expensive to scale. Launching or evolving credit, lending, and UPI products often takes months, requires heavy engineering effort, and limits the ability to create personalized customer experiences.
   

  

 At the same time, customer expectations have changed \- speed, flexibility, and tailored financial products are no longer optional. Banks and fintechs need infrastructure that allows them to innovate quickly, adapt continuously, and scale without friction.
   

  

 This is where we come in.
   

  

 At Vegapay, we are building modern, configurable fintech infrastructure that enables banks, NBFCs, and enterprises to design, launch, and manage credit and payment programs with ease. Our platform brings together flexibility, speed, and control \- helping our partners unlock new growth opportunities and deliver personalized banking experiences at scale.

We do not hire based on degrees or years of experience. We hire based on proof.

**You must:**

* Communicate clearly and confidently in English and at least one regional language (written and spoken)
* Have built or shipped something real — a prototype, a project, a tool, a product demo. It does not need to be polished. It needs to be yours.

* Have volunteered or served in a real\-world setting — NGO, community initiative, freelance work, or a family business. Life experience counts more than a grade here.

**What this programme is not**

The Firm’s International Tax Practice is one of the largest on the West Coast and its well\-recognized SEC practice serves approximately 35 public reporting companies, mostly in the technology industry.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 The HR Coordinator supports HR functions through recruitment assistance, onboarding, HR administration, employee relations, administrative support and other HR activities. This role plays a crucial part in maintaining HR operations and promoting positive employee experiences. The ideal candidate will be highly organized, detail\-oriented, and capable of accurately managing multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment, with a focus on continuous improvement and collaboration.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
**Onboarding and offboarding Support:**

* Accountable for gathering and organizing all new hire documents.
* Prepares and delivers new hire orientation while verifying new hire documents.
* Conduct 30, 60, 90 days new hire check\-ins with new hires.


**HR Operations Support:**
* Maintain employee records and HR databases, and protect sensitive information
* Prepare accurate HR records
* Preparing, maintaining and updating standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Collaborates with the HR Team for day today activities, report preparation and assist in ad\-hoc HR reports, presentations and support as required
* Handle day\-to\-day HR administrative tasks, such as attendance, leave management, and payroll coordination


**Data Management, Compliance \& Reporting:**
* Maintain accurate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS), ensuring data integrity across all talent processes.
* Assist in compiling and analyzing workforce planning data and support the preparation of reports and presentations for executive leadership.
* Assisting, maintaining and adhering to Firm related compliance requirements.
* Track and manage employee’s Paid Time Off (PTO) and Holidays
* Prepare periodic HR reports and dashboards to ensure compliance with statutory regulations.


**Talent Acquisition \& Campus Recruitment:**
* Manage the logistics of campus recruitment events, including coordinating event registrations, securing venues, and organizing promotional activities.
* Ensure that all materials and giveaways are ordered, branded, and aligned with the company’s recruitment goals.
* Assisting and coordinating onboarding new employees, employees from newly integrated firms, and global colleagues.
* Provide support and coordination for recruitment projects, working closely with supervisors, hiring managers, and HR team members.


**Project Coordination**
* Assist in planning and executing talent\-related projects such as onboarding initiatives, campus events, employee experience programs, business combinations, and global talent strategy rollouts.
* Manage project documentation, track progress against goals, and support the development and implementation of standard operating procedures (SOPs) for talent operations.


**Process Improvement \& Collaboration:**
* Facilitate communication and collaboration across HR sub\-teams to ensure a unified approach to talent management.
* Identify and address issues affecting recruitment processes, implementing activities to continuously improve efficiency.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Technology Solutions (ETS) to optimize the use of HR systems and tools.
* Serve as a resource for recruitment policies, procedures, and practices, providing guidance to colleagues, HR team members, and other stakeholders as needed.


**Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 1 to 3 years of experience in Recruiting, HR, or talent management, preferably in a global environment.
* Experience with ATS (preferably Lever) and other talent management systems.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and multitask effectively.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and HR software.
* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with a high level of professionalism.
* Detail\-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy and quality.
* Proactive problem\-solver with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Adaptable and able to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team, engaging with multiple stakeholders across different geographies.

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
**Overview**
 At Mimecast, we operate at scale—protecting billions of emails daily across a global hybrid\-cloud infrastructure. If you’re passionate about reliability, automation, and working with cutting\-edge technologies in a mission\-critical environment, this is the place for you.
   

  

**AI\-First Engineering at Mimecast**
 Mimecast is an AI\-First engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI\-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, from code development to testing, documentation, and operations. We're looking for leaders who don't just use AI tools but champion their adoption and establish new ways of working.
   

  

 Our AI leadership extends beyond how we build to what we build. Our Mihra AI agent delivers 7x faster threat response for customers, and we're recognized as "Agents of Change" in Human Risk Management. Engineers here work at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI tooling and AI\-powered security products that protect organizations worldwide.
   

  

**Why Join**
 “This is a hands\-on role in a team that’s focused on ensuring the reliability and resiliency of Mimecast’s Hybrid Cloud infrastructure. You’ll work with Kubernetes, AWS, and other exciting technologies, while building automation and Infrastructure\-as\-Code solutions to drive efficiency and scalability. If you’re eager to tackle complex challenges and grow your career in a collaborative environment, I’d love to hear from you.” – Hiring Manager, Cloud Platform
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Sustain platform resiliency: Perform infrastructure configuration and maintenance to ensure optimal performance, security, and availability.
* Maintain containerization platforms: Manage Kubernetes and AWS EKS to provide a stable platform for Mimecast’s microservices.
* Build automation: Develop reusable Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and automation to streamline infrastructure provisioning.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues: Proactively identify and resolve infrastructure issues across Linux and Kubernetes systems in a hybrid\-cloud environment, minimizing downtime.
* Enhance security: Maintain the security posture of infrastructure and platform configurations, aligning with the latest cybersecurity standards.
* Collaborate and refine processes: Work closely with the team to improve operational processes and documentation.
* Manage observability tools: Operate and maintain tools like Graphite, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic, Nagios, and LogScale.
* Support engineering teams: Provide exceptional support to internal Product and Engineering teams, meeting their requirements for Mimecast’s Cloud Platform.
* Participate in on\-call rotation: Be part of the on\-call rotation and perform out\-of\-hours maintenance work as needed.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Technical expertise: Experience in roles such as Platform Engineer, Cloud Operations, Sys Admin, or Site Reliability Engineer (SRE).
* Kubernetes proficiency: Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s) and containerization in production environments.
* Linux expertise: Strong skills in maintaining and troubleshooting Linux operating systems and distributed systems at scale.
* Infrastructure knowledge: Foundational understanding of core infrastructure services like DNS, Identity Management, load balancers, and web servers.
* Networking basics: Foundational knowledge of computer networking.
* IaC and scripting: Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools like Terraform/CloudFormation and configuration management tools like Puppet. Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language.
* Proactive mindset: A willingness to take on new challenges, deliver results, and learn new technologies quickly.
* Collaboration skills: Outstanding communication and social skills, with the ability to connect with others and problem\-solve effectively.


**What We Bring**
* Global impact: A cybersecurity company operating at genuine global scale, protecting organizations and their people.
* Engineering excellence: A Cloud Platform organization that values automation, reliability, and doing things properly.
* Competitive rewards: Competitive compensation as part of a broader total rewards package, including benefits and wellbeing programs.
* Career growth: Opportunities to develop expertise in hybrid\-cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and automation, with clear paths to senior engineering roles.
* Collaborative culture: Work alongside experienced engineers and leaders who invest in your development.


**Career Growth Opportunities**
* Develop deep expertise in hybrid\-cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and automation.
* Build strong Infrastructure\-as\-Code and automation skills in a production environment.
* Grow into senior engineering or team lead roles within Cloud Platform.
* Work alongside experienced engineers and leaders who are committed to your development.


**Manager’s Working Style \& Team’s Purpose**
 The Cloud Operations team exists to ensure the reliability and resiliency of Mimecast’s Hybrid Cloud infrastructure. The team’s purpose is to deliver a platform that is secure, performant, and scalable, enabling Product and Engineering teams to innovate faster and deliver more value to customers. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work in a collaborative environment, tackling complex challenges and contributing to the continuous improvement of Mimecast’s infrastructure. The expectation is hands\-on technical credibility combined with a proactive approach to problem\-solving and teamwork.
   

  

**Belonging at Mimecast**
 Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.
   

  

 We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.
   

  

 We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.
   

  

*Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.*
*It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.*
